veranderings.voor: Daardie manier van dink en doen se naam is stigma
veranderings.na: So 'n manier van dink en doen noem ons stigma
veranderings.rede: 'se naam is' is wooden; 'noem ons' is the natural way to introduce a term, same word count.

veranderings.voor: Dit kom uit in wat hulle doen en sê
veranderings.na: Dit blyk uit wat hulle doen en sê
veranderings.rede: 'kom uit in' calques English 'comes out in'; 'blyk uit' is the idiomatic Afrikaans and one word shorter.

veranderings.voor: Hulle wil nie 'n beker deel nie
veranderings.na: Hulle wil nie 'n beker met hom deel nie
veranderings.rede: 'deel' needs its partner here; without 'met hom' the sentence does not say whom they refuse to share with.

veranderings.voor: Al hierdie dinge maak seer en die skade
veranderings.na: Al hierdie dinge maak seer, en die skade
veranderings.rede: AWS: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.

veranderings.voor: en die vrees is nie waar nie
veranderings.rede: A fear is not 'true' or 'untrue'; 'klop nie' is the idiomatic expression and matches the block heading.

veranderings.voor: Niks van daardie gewone dinge bring MIV na jou toe nie
veranderings.na: Nie een van daardie gewone dinge gee jou MIV nie
veranderings.rede: 'bring MIV na jou toe' is unnatural and 'niks van' sits awkwardly with countable things; same word count.

veranderings.blok: Jy kry nie MIV van hierdie dinge nie
veranderings.rede: In an infinitive-style phrase the verb goes last, as in the parallel item 'Saam speel en langs mekaar in die klas sit'.

veranderings.blok: Mense wat met MIV leef, leef gewone lewens
veranderings.voor: drink elke dag medisyne en dit hou
veranderings.na: drink elke dag medisyne, en dit hou
veranderings.rede: AWS: 'dit hou hulle gesond' has its own subject and verb, so a comma goes before 'en'; the protected wording is untouched.

veranderings.blok: Wat jy self anders kan doen
veranderings.rede: 'verander by' is the wrong preposition; an attitude changes through ('deur') small daily actions.

veranderings.blok: Wat jy self anders kan doen
veranderings.voor: nooi hom saam om te speel
veranderings.na: nooi hom om saam te speel
veranderings.rede: 'nooi hom om saam te speel' is the natural order; same words.

veranderings.blok: Wat jy self anders kan doen
veranderings.rede: 'aandra' also means telling tales to an adult ('klik'), which sits badly beside the instructions to tell an adult; 'versprei' says only spreading gossip.

veranderings.blok: Wat jy self anders kan doen
veranderings.voor: Sê iets wanneer iemand geterg word, of gaan haal 'n grootmens
veranderings.na: Sê iets of gaan haal 'n grootmens wanneer iemand geterg word
veranderings.rede: Putting both commands together removes the comma before a subjectless command half and the misreading 'iemand ... gaan haal 'n grootmens'; same words, same meaning.

veranderings.blok: Wat jy self anders kan doen
veranderings.rede: The nearest antecedent of 'hy' is 'n grootmens', so the safety instruction can be read as the adult getting hurt; naming the friend removes that.

veranderings.blok: Wat jy self anders kan doen
veranderings.na: Behandel hom in die eerste plek as
veranderings.rede: 'eerste' as an adverb here copies English 'first'; Afrikaans says 'in die eerste plek' (reviewer may prefer simply dropping 'eerste' to save words).

veranderings.blok: As stigma jou of jou gesin tref
veranderings.rede: 'bly' plus a verb for 'keep on' is colloquial and reads like a contradiction beside 'gaan'; 'steeds' is clearer, same word count.

veranderings.blok: As stigma jou of jou gesin tref
veranderings.rede: 'lelik is' can be read as 'are ugly'; 'lelik optree' clearly means behave nastily, same word count.

veranderings.voor: Die woorde wat ons kies dra
veranderings.na: Die woorde wat ons kies, dra
veranderings.rede: A comma after the relative clause before the main verb, as the lesson does elsewhere ('Iemand wat bang is vir ander se woorde, hou').
A comma before 'omdat' separates the two uses of 'leef' and makes the point of the sentence easier to see; the protected wording is untouched.

veranderings.voor: wat hy het of is, en hom daarom
veranderings.na: wat hy het of is en hom daarom
veranderings.rede: AWS: the 'en' half has no subject of its own (it shares 'mense'), so no comma before 'en'.

vlae.blok: Mense wat met MIV leef, leef gewone lewens
vlae.teks: Jy sal nie aan iemand kan sien dat sy met MIV leef nie.
vlae.rede: Everywhere else the lesson refers to 'iemand' as 'hy'; 'sy' here may be a deliberate gender balance, so not changed, but a person may want to confirm it is intended.
